title: cli test: package-install-local-jobs-shared-name SIGKILLs its first install at a fixed 120 s under full-suite load — a false red from `pnpm test` on a 4 vCPU box
body:
Filing-gate category: ① — a reproducible defect with a named location (test infrastructure).
reach: the public entry `pnpm test` (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 1), measured once on a 4 vCPU / 15 GiB container at `f0fdd45bbc`: a false red.
Who acts: the seat that owns `packages/cli` tests (`domain:server` after #25247). The fix is one test file.
Duplicate search: `package-install-local-jobs-shared-name integration test timeout` — 3 hits (#24100, #21602, #21489, all closed). None is about this timeout.

## What happened

On `main` `f0fdd45bbc`, a full `pnpm test` (turbo, `--concurrency=50%`, `VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=3` from `scripts/vitest-worker-cap.mjs`) on a 4 vCPU container produced:

```text
@objectstack/cli:test:  ❯  integration  test/package-install-local-jobs-shared-name.integration.test.ts (9 tests | 6 failed) 209590ms
      × all three packages install (exit 0)
      × … and each later package's job runs too
      × the catalogue: the first package keeps the authored name; …
      × … and only its own: ALPHA and GAMMA run on
      × after a restart, both rehydrated packages run
      × uninstalling the holder of the bare name (ALPHA) stops its job, …
```

Run on its own on the same machine and tree (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/package-install-local-jobs-shared-name.integration.test.ts`), it passes 9/9 in 75.9 s. The whole `@objectstack/cli` suite, run alone with `VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=3`, also passes: 497 files, 6271 tests. Hourly CI on `main` is green for this file.

## Why (from the source)

`packageInstall()` (line ~252) gives each `os package install` child a hard `setTimeout(() => child.kill('SIGKILL'), 120_000)`. The `beforeAll` runs three installs in sequence against a live `os start`. In the loaded run the file took 209 s in total, so the first install was SIGKILLed at 120 s. The first assertion (`exit 0`) failed, and the five assertions that read its results failed after it.

This is the same shape as #25298 / #25319: a wall-clock budget set for an idle machine. It goes red under suite load, while the code is correct.

## What done looks like

- On a loaded runner the install leg fails only when the install is actually broken, not when the box is busy. For example, take the budget from the shared CLI spawner helpers (#24396) or a load-aware ceiling. Do not just raise the number.
- Verify: a full `pnpm test` on a 4 vCPU container goes green for this file, and an ablation that breaks the install still turns it red.
